And then I have hosted my app in shinyapps.io, and without error it has uploaded into shinyapps.io, but when I try to access the page through URl 
1. It shuts down abruptly after running for few seconds.

Why is this happening in shinyapps.io ? please let me know.

Harish,

First, for your postings related to shinyapps.io, please post to the following discussion forum:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shinyapps-users

About your issue, one way you can troubleshoot the problem is by showing the logs. Please refer to this article, section on Application Logging.

I think your problem is caused by having a call to "install.packages" in your server.R. You cannot do this on shinyapps.io.

Best,
Fereshteh
